mapper.select: SELECT tradeCalendarId from ( SELECT T5.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID tradeCalendarId, T5.CALENDARNAME calendarName, GROUP_CONCAT(T5.CALENDAR_ID order by T5.CALENDAR_ID asc SEPARATOR '/') CALENDAR_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(T5.CALENDAR_ID order by T5.CALENDAR_ID desc SEPARATOR '/') CALENDAR_ID_EX FROM (SELECT T3.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, T3.CALENDAR_ID, T3.CALENDAR_NAME CALENDARNAME, T4.CALENDAR_NAME CALENDARTYPE FROM (SELECT T1.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T2.CALENDAR_NAME FROM MST_TRADE_CALENDAR T1 LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO T2 ON T1.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = T2.CALENDAR_ID WHERE T2.IS_TRADE_CALENDAR = 'Y') T3 LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO T4 ON T4.CALENDAR_ID = T3.CALENDAR_ID AND T4.IS_TRADE_CALENDAR != 'Y') T5 GROUP BY T5.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, T5.CALENDARNAME ) WHERE CALENDAR_ID = #{curPair} OR CALENDAR_ID_EX = #{curPair}
